motion: The camera does not move. The old woman zips her white suit up to her chin with a look of deep suspicion. The woman in the cream jumper on the right looks at nobody and speaks, deadpan and quick, under her breath. She says: Five years, one toilet. Now he's fussy. Then she closes her mouth and tugs her suit up over her shoulders. Behind them people struggle into their white suits. The camera does not move.
